description: Added spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency to enable Azure Managed Identity authentication for PostgreSQL. This dependency provides Spring Boot integration for passwordless authentication.

Migrated from password-based PostgreSQL authentication to Azure Managed Identity-based authentication. Changes include: (1) Removed hardcoded password from configuration, (2) Updated JDBC URL to use Azure PostgreSQL endpoint with environment variables, (3) Added passwordless-enabled property, (4) Changed username from hardcoded to managed identity name via environment variable, (5) Added comprehensive comments for managed identity, service principal, and sovereign cloud deployments.
